U01 — Trusted Baseline Engine (P0): Pull only authorized tenant/business/site/period operational snapshots, preserve source record IDs and transaction cutoffs; prevent accidental mixture of stale sources.
Given same authorized source snapshot and scope, baselines are reproducible and inaccessible to other businesses.
U02 — Data Quality & Readiness (P0): Identify missing, stale, incomplete, estimated and unverified inventory/cost/sales/finance data; add explicit data readiness flags and corrective prompts.
Unknown is not zero; incomplete financial results cannot masquerade as certified profit/cashflow.
U03 — Certified Model Registry (P0): Register typed formulas, numeric units, supported business packs, dependencies, versions, tested/partial/unavailable status and fixture certification.
Unverified models cannot be tagged Ready, and saved outputs retain the exact original formula version.

U04 — Financial Definition Engine (P0): Canonical revenue, contribution, cost, margin, net profit, cashflow, debt/equity/interest, returns, taxes, fiscal periods, currency and accounting basis definitions.
Different pages using the same canonical business data and period agree or explain the difference.
U05 — Scenario Provenance (P0): Capture model ID/version, data snapshot hash/ref, inputs/overrides, units, author, source time, business/location/period, warnings and history.
Saved scenarios can be reproduced without changing historical interpretation when live ERP data later changes.

U06 — Cross-Module Impact Engine (P0): Link effects on stock, purchasing, recipes/BOM, manufacturing, delivery, sales, staff, cash, financial obligations and approvals; apply explicit dependency graph without implicit double counting.
Branch expansion example shows upstream production/supply/cash effects and explains missing links.

U07 — Feasibility & Constraint Engine (P0): Budget, cash buffer, supplier lead time, transport, plant/warehouse capacity, staff hours, machine throughput, space, project limits and availability windows.
An infeasible decision is identified with exact breached constraint; it is not shown as readily executable.

U08 — Integrated Financial Modeling (P0): Link profit-and-loss, timing of receipts/payments, working capital, assets/liabilities, loans, principal, investor distribution and restricted cash; staged balance-sheet logic only where ledger contracts support it.
Illustrative profitable-but-cash-negative scenario reconciles, no principal repayment counted as operating expense by mistake.
U09 — Sensitivity & Driver Analysis (P0): One-way, multi-variable and break-even threshold impact of price, volume, cost, lead time, discount, FX, rent, staff and term length.
Top drivers and exact assumption deltas reconcile to base scenario; all variable bounds validated.
U10 — Risk & Stress Testing (P1): Named shocks and combined stress cases: demand fall, inflation, interest/return obligation, vendor delay, breakdown, staffing shortage and project slippage.
Every stress result displays assumptions and range, not a claimed guaranteed future outcome.
U11 — Reverse Goal Planning (P1): Target profit, cash reserve, sales, working capital, service level or capacity with inverse calculation of feasible price/volume/cost and resource requirements.
Shows when target is impossible under existing constraints instead of inventing unattainable numbers.
U12 — Constraint-Based Optimization (P1): Compare feasible resource/budget/capacity/stock/production allocation choices against owner-selected objective (cash, margin, service, risk).
Result declares objective and tradeoffs; honors all hard constraints and never substitutes recommendation for owner approval.
U13 — Multi-Scenario Portfolio (P1): Combine owner-authorized scenarios across same portfolio/business/period and expose concurrent capex, cash, people, stock and machine contention.
Two individually feasible branch expansions with joint cash shortage are flagged; no independent tenant blending.
U14 — Advanced Uncertainty Models (P2): Optional probability/range or Monte Carlo only with validated input distributions, correlations, model suitability and documented confidence limits.
Missing statistical basis disables probability claims; output clearly distinguishes illustration from calibrated probability.
U15 — Decision Lifecycle Register (P0): Draft → Simulated → Reviewed → Approved/Rejected → Eligible-to-Apply → Applied → Monitored → Closed with actor/role/timestamp and state history.
No direct skipping of required approval gates; approved decisions remain traceable to exact scenario/version.
U16 — Approval Workflow Integration (P0): Reuse canonical ERP request/approval service with financial/operational authority, segregation of duties and delegated thresholds.
No new parallel approval engine; rejected/unauthorized execution is blocked at server.
U17 — Actual vs Plan Tracking (P0): Store baseline plan from approved simulation and reconcile future real P&L, volumes, stock, staff, capital and cash outcomes with period/location scopes.
After 30/90 days actuals, variance is derived from verifiable records and planned assumptions.
U18 — Decision Performance Review (P0): Owner sees actual net benefit, liquidity impact, constraint incidence, ROI/payback when valid, variance reasons and retrospective decision notes.
Reviewed case shows realized vs projected outcome without rewriting the historical simulation.
U19 — Forecast Accuracy & Bias (P1): Track comparable forecast-vs-actual accuracy by model, input data period, business, category and horizon; identify persistent bias.
Quality checks handle missing actuals, data leakage, changed definitions and incomparable periods.
U20 — Early Warning & Replanning (P1): Detect cash gaps, stockout, capacity bottlenecks, financing due, large variance and delays; propose refresh/replan, optional authorized alert workflows.
Owner sees evidence and threshold; no automation silently modifies the operational plan.
U21 — Collaborative Scenario Review (P1): Role-scoped scenario comments, reviewer roles, business manager/accountant/production advice, attachments and review evidence.
Staff cannot retrieve restricted finance details/other businesses through collaboration or exported reports.

U22 — Multi-Business Consolidation (P0): Business/brand/site/factory/warehouse/project comparisons with tenant boundaries, elimination of internal movements, compatible currency/period/accounting bases.
Portfolio summary reconciles without double counting internal transfer or external tenant data.

U23 — Investment & Financing Integration (P0): Draw on verified partner/loan agreement definitions: equity, actual-profit shares, principal-based contractual return, loan, repayment/interest, maturity, investor liquidity claims.
Financing cases show cash obligations and classification accurately; no global all-locations aggregation bug.

U24 — Secure Scenario Application (P0): Separate simulation read sandbox from proposals; explicit before/after diff, permission and approvals, only domain-validated transactional action, idempotency and audit/recovery; unsupported Apply remains advisory-only.

U25 — Enterprise UX & Reporting (P0): One Simulation Lab + Contextual Quick Simulation, BN/EN support, mobile/tablet/desktop, charts, comparative tables, saved search/export, usable accessibility and safe errors.
